steps.note: Open a suitable existing live RFQ while keeping the buyer session available.
Switch to the invited vendor's separate supplier-portal session.
Open the event's RFQ bid sheet in the vendor portal.
Choose a definitively past date in the vendor's Delivery by column.
Capture the exact date displayed in the vendor portal for comparison with the buyer view.
Assert the known vendor-portal submission confirmation on the acceptance path.
Return to the buyer session to inspect the submitted value.
Open the event overview where the buyer can see the vendor's delivery date.
Assert that the buyer's Delivery by date matches the date selected by the vendor.
